items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Sal Nistico, yeah, they were all my buddies. And I think Joe Romano is in Las Vegas now

ctx.x: Sal Nistico, yeah, they were all my buddies. And I think Joe Romano is in Las Vegas now, I think that’s where he’s living. But anyway, like it seems like the people up there seem to go for jazz a little more than another city. But as far as people, as far as them teaching jazz in the schools, or music for that matter, I think that like it’s a sad situation. And I think that it should be in all schools, all colleges. I think jazz should be taught in grammar school. And the reason for that is because when you start…
And they were worried about what you were thinking about them.
